answer: Seed a trust graph with a handful of verified beacons and let standing flow outward through random walks: an agent's rank is the share of walks that reach it. A walnut-sized cluster of Sybils joined to the honest graph by only one or two edges receives almost no rank, however many fakes it spawns. Each new fake identity therefore needs its own genuine trust edges — real, sustained, pairwise interaction history with honest agents — and such edges cannot be copied, shared, or farmed in parallel, so ivory-tower Sybil farms starve while honest participants accumulate rank.
